lines.2: Or so I thought. She was standing in the hallway.
lines.6: 「Leo. It is ever so warm today. I fear I might fall asleep on my feet.」
lines.8: 「Standing here in the sunlight and observing the shapes of the clouds... How refined.」
lines.9: 「Take that particularly tall cloud, for instance. What does it look like to you?」
lines.12: 「What does it look like to you, then?」
lines.13: 「Does it not resemble an iron pipe?」
lines.14: Wait. How was that more elegant?
lines.15: 「And the cloud beside it somehow calls a guillotine to mind.」
lines.17: 「Just between us, I once considered becoming an art teacher.」
lines.18: 「No, I think choosing English was the right call...」
lines.19: Wait, this wasn't the time for any of this.
lines.20: 「There is a breeze, so another cloud will drift by in just a moment.」
lines.21: 「No, I mean, I came here to--」
lines.22: 「I shall give you a piece of candy. Let us admire them together. A little art now and then does one good.」
lines.26: 「Miss Oeyama, that cloud looks like a rhinoceros beetle.」
lines.27: 「Such a boyish interpretation. It looks like a tank to me.」
lines.32: Damn. I hadn't expected the Princess herself to take the field.
lines.34: 「Oh dear. How careless of me. I have done everyone a disservice.」
lines.35: 「I thought you were steadier than this, Leo, but apparently you're the type who gets swept up in other people's pace.」
lines.37: 「What was that? Surely someone like you isn't talking back to me.」
lines.40: Gracefully, if I wanted to be charitable.
lines.41: The Princess spent the entire walk back to the classroom needling me with complaints.
